ns2:course.label: Risk Measurement/Reporting I
ns2:course.description: Application of the concepts of risk and uncertainty to the financial management of organizations in achieving business objectives and strategies, with an emphasis on the role of accounting measurement and reporting in the management of such risks. Focuses on integrating knowledge acquired from behavioral, economic, finance, and accounting perspectives. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent enrollment in ACCY 510; FIN 300 or equivalent, and enrollment in graduate accounting degree program or consent of department.
